# synthetic fixture mimicking `systemctl --help` (systemd is LGPL-2.1;
# format reproduced by hand, no verbatim capture — see ../NOTICE.md)
jym-systemctl [OPTIONS...] COMMAND ...

Query or send control commands to the system manager.

Commands:
  is-system-running                   Check whether system is fully running
  daemon-reload                       Reload manager configuration
  daemon-reexec                       Reexecute the manager
  default                             Enter system default mode
  poweroff                            Shut down and power-off the system
  reboot                              Shut down and reboot the system
  list-units [PATTERN...]             List units currently in memory
  status [PATTERN...|PID...]          Show runtime status of one or more units
  show [PATTERN...|JOB...]            Show properties of units or the manager
  start UNIT...                       Start (activate) one or more units
  stop UNIT...                        Stop (deactivate) one or more units
  enable UNIT...                      Enable one or more unit files
  disable UNIT...                     Disable one or more unit files
